_comment: Phantom OPS v0 bridge configuration. See app/README.md.

commands._comment: Commands are only sent to AP addresses listed here. 6041 = SIL. Add a hardware AP address only deliberately.

map._comment: Offline basemap, read by the web server (vite.config.ts), not the bridge. offlineDir: folder with .pmtiles extracts, absolute or relative to app/. offlineFile: which one to use (empty = first by name). See README "Offline maps".

replay._comment: Set a path to record every received datagram (JSON lines) for later replay.
